newsitem.title: USA: Houston says $400 mln water bond sale on hold.
newsitem.headline: Houston says $400 mln water bond sale on hold.

text.p: Houston's water and sewer department, which is considering a $400 million refunding bond sale through Merrill Lynch, said the offering is on hold until fixed-income yields fall further.
"It's up in the air," said an official with the city controller, who requested anonymity.

He said that, when the refunding first was planned, the yield on the 30-year Treasury bond was approximately 6.22 percent. While the market has recovered much of the ground it lost over the past two weeks, with the benchmark Treasuries on Thursday gaining 29 ticks to yield 6.56 percent, city officials and the underwriting syndicate do yet see sufficient savings to go ahead with the refunding.
Saying he could not forecast the market, the Houston official added he could not say when a final decision would be reached.
